propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate planned the replacement of a cup filler and a case erector with a baseline schedule and tracked committed and actual cost against the approved budget.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the schedule and cost tracking directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the site acceptance test protocol for the new filler with the production and quality leads and recorded results and deviations.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the protocol work, the work sample is the signed test record and the plant engineering manager confirmed it in writing.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds the Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
propositions.rationale: The certification appears only as the candidate's own remark on a screening call, with no certificate, number, date or register check; the qualification rule forbids calling a candidate certified without explicit cited evidence.

expectedGap: The PMP certification is not established; it rests on the candidate's remark during screening, with no certificate number, award date or register record.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the documented planning, supplier, acceptance-test and capital reporting work and the confirmed filler project; do not describe the candidate as PMP certified.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the PMP certification number and award date so the certification can be checked on PMI's online certification registry.
